svg.title: Video producer pipeline
svg.desc: A text task passes the L44, L34 and L35 gates, an LLM writes a storyboard of up to six scenes (local Ollama by default, Anthropic when a key is set and egress admits it), gTTS narrates each scene via Google, Pillow draws a slide per scene, ffmpeg encodes and joins, output is an MP4 plus SRT captions.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: From one sentence to a narrated video

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Marketplace plugin video_producer — a text task in, an MP4 with SRT captions out.
